_description: ISCA'27 v4 Complete (user 2026-10-21: drop the components that showed no benefit): M1 = requester in-flight merge (-t18-req-merge, dedup owner m1) + pack (same-page bitmap batching + prefetch piggyback), allocation = shared pool (-t18-credit-policy shared); M3 = requester-L2 retention with kernel-boundary invalidation. Removed vs v3_complete: owner merge (-t18-owner-merge=false), in-network multicast M2 (-t18-owner-multicast=false), distance allocation rtt (shared instead). Window t18-window 64, composed requester table 128. Same as v3_complete_alloc_shared except owner merge and multicast off.
